source_semantics.review: Do not wholesale adopt this rules_browsers/Bazel/web-test-runner harness migration. The old36-line initializer and new40-line initializer are equal after removing exactly three newly added side-effect imports (zone.js, zone.js/testing, reflect-metadata), but loading responsibility/order changes along with Karma bootstrap removal and Bazel bootstrap/spec bundling. Both originals retain experimental zoneless setup and a throwing ErrorHandler, which is distinct from the owned explicit public zoneful runner. The upstream legacy bundler adds treeShaking:false, changes async Sass compilation to synchronous compile plus deferred writes and uses the new initializer path. Three key-manager suites replace suite-this context with explicitly owned context objects; the82 complete case callbacks remain equal but hook/registration context differs. Preserve the owned runner public stability/error behavior and actual discovery/lifetime/floor obligations; never restore the removed false-stability shortcut or infer a native suite pass from these source frames.
